mapper.insert: INSERT INTO spi_extension_config ( binding_ids, spi_interface, extension_name, class_name, source_code, description, enabled, extension_mode ) VALUES ( #{bindingIds, typeHandler=com.helianhealth.agent.common.typehandler.ListIntegerTypeHandler}, #{spiInterface}, #{extensionName}, #{className}, #{sourceCode}, #{description}, #{enabled}, #{extensionMode} )
mapper.update: UPDATE spi_extension_config SET binding_ids = #{bindingIds, typeHandler=com.helianhealth.agent.common.typehandler.ListIntegerTypeHandler}, class_name = #{className}, source_code = #{sourceCode}, description = #{description}, enabled = #{enabled}, extension_name = #{extensionName}, extension_mode = #{extensionMode} WHERE config_id = #{configId}
